fact: On 4 June 2024 the Director General of Customs said the GAINDE 2000 system had that year come into force at Rosso, Ziguinchor, Sénoba and Kaolack and would reach all customs offices within six months, at the 20th anniversary of the ORBUS single window.
title: 20 ans de ORBUS : L'heure de chanter les mérites de la dématérialisation
